_what: Producer profile: the rules BeatDrop follows for this producer. For other producers this gets built automatically (see PRODUCT-NOTES.md).

pairings._why: Only artists who actually run together. Taken from what ranks in YouTube search for each lane artist (2026-10-05 research).

rules: Collab producers go in the description only, never the title or thumbnail.
Thumbnail = the artist photo, full frame. No text, no blur. BPM and key go in the description.
No guns, no other channels' watermarks or logos, no screenshots with app UI in thumbnails.
Pair only artists who actually make music together or share a lane.
Check by sound that a beat isn't already on the channel (dedupe.py) before uploading.
Stay consistent: mostly the same focus artists every week to own that search lane.
